sources.title: Batch 0032 exact packet with recovered examples
Writer relation fixture plus exhaustive independent involution oracle

claims.text: Source requires symmetric x<->y replacement and preserves aabba->eeffe true plus asdf->asag false, without defining arbitrary multi-round swap semantics.
Actual candidate enforces one symmetric partner per constrained code point; exhaustive brute-involution review validates all small-domain mappings.
Implementation operates on Unicode code points and passes a non-BMP swap boundary.

validation.reported_stdout: PASS writer randomized=20000; PASS exhaustive independent pairs=597871

boundary_tests.expected: actual equals existence of one of all four involutions over abc for every string pair length 0..6
non-BMP pair swap works, length mismatch false, null rejected

findings: Recovered source explicitly requires x->y to imply y->x and gives both a true and false example; the candidate preserves those details.
The one-global-involution interpretation is clearly marked as the implemented contract, while arbitrary multi-round swap semantics are explicitly left outside the preserved source.
The partner-map invariant is sufficient and constructive: every constrained code point has exactly one symmetric partner or itself.

Independent review enumerates all involutions over a three-character alphabet and all 597,871 source/target pairs through length six against the compiled actual candidate, plus Unicode and API boundaries.
Code-point handling supports non-BMP characters without falsely claiming grapheme-cluster semantics.
O(n) expected time and O(u) state match one scan and a hash map over constrained characters.
